text.en: Module K: Is K11b coded Yes?
text.hi: माड्यूल K: क्या K11b 'हाँ' कोडित है?

text.en: Module K: Is K12a coded Yes?
text.hi: माड्यूल K: क्या K12a 'हाँ' कोडित है?

text.en: Circle Yes if a delusional idea is identified in A3e or in any psychotic feature in K1 through K7.
text.hi: 'हाँ' घेरें यदि A3e में या K1–K7 की किसी मनर्विकारी विशेषता में भ्रामक विचार चिह्नित हो।

text.en: Circle Yes if a delusional idea is identified in C3a or in any psychotic feature in K1 through K7.
text.hi: 'हाँ' घेरें यदि C3a में या K1–K7 की किसी मनर्विकारी विशेषता में भ्रामक विचार चिह्नित हो।

specifierNotes.en: Mixed features: hypo/manic with mixed features = hypo/manic + at least 3 symptoms from A3; depressed with mixed features = major depressive episode + at least 3 symptoms from C3.
specifierNotes.hi: मिश्र-लक्षण: हाइपो/मैैनिक मिश्र-लक्षणों सहित = हाइपो/मैैनिक + A3 के कम से कम 3 लक्षण; अवसादित मिश्र-लक्षणों सहित = प्रमुख अवसादी एपिसोड + C3 के कम से कम 3 लक्षण।

specifierNotes.en: With anxious distress = with at least 3 symptoms from N3.
specifierNotes.hi: आतंक-पीड़ा सहित = N3 के कम से कम 3 लक्षण।

diagnosticBoxes.rule: MAJOR DEPRESSIVE EPISODE coded Yes (current or past) AND MANIC EPISODE No (current and past) AND HYPOMANIC EPISODE No (current and past) AND organic cause ruled out (O2 summary). Specify if the depressive episode is current or past or both. With psychotic features, CURRENT: if 1b OR 2a (current) = Yes; PAST: if 1a OR 2a (past) = Yes.

MANIC EPISODE coded Yes (current or past) AND organic cause ruled out (O2 summary). Single manic episode: if manic episode (current or past) Yes AND major depressive episode (current and past) No. With psychotic features, CURRENT: if 1b OR 2a (current) OR 2b (current) = Yes; PAST: if 1a OR 2a (past) OR 2b (past) = Yes. Specify most recent episode (manic/depressed/hypomanic, mutually exclusive) and whether it had mixed, anxious or psychotic features, and severity (mild/moderate/severe).

MAJOR DEPRESSIVE EPISODE Yes (current or past) AND HYPOMANIC EPISODE Yes (current or past) AND MANIC EPISODE No (current and past) AND organic cause ruled out (O2 summary). Specify if bipolar disorder is current or past or both; most recent mood episode hypomanic or depressed (mutually exclusive); most recent episode with mixed/anxious/psychotic features; severity mild/moderate/severe.

label.en: Other Specified Bipolar and Related Disorder — Current / Past
label.hi: अन्य निर्दिष्ट बाइपोलर एवं संबंधित विकार — वर्तमान / अतीत

diagnosticBoxes.rule: Either: MAJOR DEPRESSIVE EPISODE No (current and past) AND MANIC EPISODE No (current and past) AND C4b Yes for the appropriate timeframe AND C8b Yes; OR: MANIC EPISODE No (current and past) AND HYPOMANIC EPISODE No (current and past) AND C4a Yes for the appropriate timeframe AND C8c Yes. Specify if current or past or both.

note.en: Additional optional interview assessments (pages 36 & 37 of the MINI user-scripted version): this algorithm derives its diagnostic boxes from Modules A, C and K plus the O2 summary; it adds no new interview questions.
note.hi: अतिरिक्त वैकल्पिक साक्षात्कार मूल्यांकन (MINI उपयोगकर्ता-स्क्रिप्टेड संस्करण के पृष्ठ 36 एवं 37): यह एल्गोरिद्म माड्यूल A, C, K तथा O2 सारांश से निदान-बक्से व्युत्पन्न करता है; कोई नया साक्षात्कार-प्रश्न नहीं जोड़ता।
